caption:
ARE THE WARRIORS FOR REAL? 💛💙🎮 The numbers say maybe (standings after MON 11/9)

🪜 8-3 is only 4th in the West right now
⛰️ But we started 0-3 and haven't lost since: 8 straight. Only San Antonio (9) has a longer streak
🔥 120.4 points a night, 2nd in the NBA behind the Lakers (122.1)
🏠 The catch: 6 of the 8 wins came at Chase Center. Home 6-1, road 2-2
💪 Statement win: 112-95 over the Lakers, who sit 1st in the West at 10-2
📈 Point differential +9.2, 3rd in the West behind the Spurs (+11.7) and Wolves (+11.1)

Contender or pretender? 👇

beats.head: ARE THE WARRIORS FOR REAL?
beats.vo: Are the Warriors a real contender out west? The numbers say: maybe. More than you think.

beats.head: THE STANDINGS
beats.vo: Eight and three is only fourth in the West.

beats.head: BUT LOOK AT THE CLIMB
beats.vo: But look at the climb. We started oh and three.

beats.head: TOP OF THE MOUNTAIN
beats.vo: We haven't lost since. Eight straight, and only San Antonio has a longer streak.

beats.head: AND THE OFFENSE
beats.vo: And the offense: one hundred twenty point four a night. Second in the NBA, behind the Lakers.

beats.head: THE CATCH: HOME COOKING
beats.sub: 6 OF THE 8 WINS AT CHASE CENTER
beats.vo: The catch: six of the eight wins came at Chase Center. On the road, we're just two and two.

beats.head: THE STATEMENT WIN
beats.vo: The statement win: we beat the Lakers by seventeen. Today, LA sits first in the West.

beats.head: POINT DIFFERENTIAL
beats.vo: Our point differential is plus nine point two. Third in the West, behind San Antonio and Minnesota.

beats.head: THE REAL TEST
beats.vo: The real test starts Wednesday. Five straight on the road: Houston, San Antonio, New Orleans, Dallas, Memphis.

beats.head: NEXT BOSS: SAN ANTONIO
beats.vo: And Friday in San Antonio: the only team in the NBA with a longer streak than ours.

facts.claim: ESPN standings after Mon 11/9 (West, by seed): 1 LAL 10-2, 2 SA 9-2 (W9, +11.7), 3 OKC 8-2, 4 GS 8-3 (W8, +9.2, 120.4 PPG, home 6-1, road 2-2), 5 MIN 8-3 (+11.1), 6 HOU 8-3 (+9.1). Most points per game in the NBA: LAL 122.1, then GS 120.4 (2nd). GS point differential 3rd in the West. Longest active streak: SA 9; GS 8 is second.

Warriors schedule: started 0-3 (L @LAL 105-127, L vs MEM 108-111, L @PHX 122-131), then won 8 straight: @DEN, @MIN, vs LAL 112-95 (Fri 10/30), vs LAC, vs PHX, vs MIA, vs ORL, vs NO; 6 of the 8 wins at Chase Center. Next 5 games all on the road: Wed 11/11 @HOU 9:30 PM ET, Fri 11/13 @SA 9:30 PM ET, Mon 11/16 @NO 8 PM ET, Wed 11/18 @DAL 9:30 PM ET, Thu 11/19 @MEM 8 PM ET
